body.name: Binary-to-many-arm grouping channel
body.construction: Partition \([K]\) into fixed blocks \(G_0,G_1\) of sizes \(g_0=\lfloor K/2\rfloor\) and \(g_1=\lceil K/2\rceil\). Given a binary observation \((X,B,Y)\), \(\mathsf G_K\) draws \(A\) uniformly from \(G_B\), independently of \(Y\) conditional on \((X,B)\), and outputs \((X,A,Y)\); every arm in \(G_b\) inherits the conditional outcome mean of binary treatment \(b\), and a full-data completion draws arm potential outcomes with those inherited means independently of \(A\) conditional on \(X\).
